$comment: S3178: the source-controlled boundary between the two Wear artifacts.
The `standard` flavor is what Google Play distributes and is an ALLOWLIST: a capability is absent from it
unless it is named under `standardAllowlist`. `noLegal` is the sideload artifact and keeps everything.
Every noLegal-only category below names the permissions, components and routes that carry it, so returning
one capability to the store variant is a reviewable edit of this file rather than a silent manifest change.
Read by scripts/quality/assert-wear-store-boundary.ps1, which judges the two merged manifests against it.

standardAllowlist.$comment: The whole surface the first Play publication offers. Nothing outside this list may appear in the standard merged manifest or its route graph.

libraryContributed.$comment: Declarations no source file in this module writes - they arrive from a dependency manifest or from the debug build type. They are allowlisted by name rather than by a wildcard, so a library that starts contributing something sensitive still surfaces as an unnamed declaration.

noLegalOnly.$comment: Media read/write and viewing: the watch's own media, the browse graph, the players and the document viewer.
The recorder, its foreground microphone session and the note list it writes.
Network sources, SMB aliases, credential entry and the stream catalog. Credential entry was already withheld by S2486; here the transport itself goes too.
The Network Monitor mini-program, the watch's own system report and the Tourist telemetry dashboard - device and usage data Play treats as sensitive.
Visible Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth adapter state, read by the Network Monitor. Separate from the diagnostics category because the permission family is reviewed on its own.
Heart rate, blood pressure and activity/motion readings. Already confined by S2457, S2458 and S2995; recorded here so the one policy answers for the whole boundary.
The phone may ask this watch for a picture of its own screen over the Data Layer. No permission carries it - the component is the whole capability.
Handing a file to another application on the watch, and moving content between the watch and the paired phone.

The entry points that reach the categories above without passing through a screen. FOREGROUND_SERVICE is here rather than under one capability because every foreground service this module starts belongs to an excluded category.
